title: Hurricane Maria: Assesment on Powerlines (30 sec)
description: U.S. Army Colonel John P. Lloyd, Commander of the Army Corps of Engineers, civilian member of the Army Corps of Engineers, and Ronald Hopgood, a PREPA representative, survey the east side of Puerto Rico to assess damaged power lines around the island, Oct. 18, 2017, Puerto Rico.The Federal Emergency Management Agency and its federal partners continue 24-hour operations to conduct life-saving rescue and medical missions. (US Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Franklin Harris)
